description: This Java class 'LoggedEvent' is designed to represent an event log entry, capturing key attributes such as event type, business date, and idempotency key based on an EventMessage object.

classes.name: LoggedEvent
classes.description: Represents a logged event with type, business date, and idempotency key, constructed from an EventMessage.

methods.name: LoggedEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LoggedEvent object from an EventMessage by extracting its type, business date (formatted as ISO_LOCAL_DATE), and idempotency key.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to output a JSON-like string containing idempotencyKey, type, and businessDate.
